combat_progression.rationale: Complete deterministic combat loop with enemies, firing, collision scoring, life loss, invulnerability, game-over, and time/score-based escalation.
evidence: src/game/engine.ts:51-67, 80-157 implements spawning, firing, movement, escape life loss, difficulty-based cadence, collision resolution, and game-over.
src/game/collision.ts:20-55 awards score, consumes projectiles, removes lives, and applies invulnerability.
browser-evaluator.log:105-145 observed 8 enemies, score 100, and game-over state; test.log:6-19 reports 24 passing tests.

visual_design.rationale: Strong cohesive neon art direction, readable hierarchy, responsive presentation, grid/glow effects, and usable touch styling; gameplay feedback remains relatively sparse and geometry is simple.
evidence: desktop-before.png and desktop-after.png visibly show the navy/neon palette, grid, rounded panels, strong typography, glowing player/enemy treatment, and leaderboard state change.
mobile.png visibly shows responsive wrapping, readable HUD, compact game stage, and dedicated directional/FIRE controls.

src/game/render.ts:13-70 implements gradients, grid, entity colors, glows, and game-over dimming; src/styles.css:29-163 and 283-383 implements responsive layout, button states, touch controls, and reduced-motion styling.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: Loading, empty, unavailable, error/retry, labels, live status, focus visibility, and reduced-motion handling are all evidenced.
evidence: src/App.tsx:31-55 and src/components/Leaderboard.tsx:20-34 implement loading, empty, unavailable, error, and retry states.
src/components/StatusMessage.tsx:7-16, src/components/Hud.tsx:10-28, and src/components/TouchControls.tsx:22-55 provide semantic roles and accessible labels.
src/styles.css:159-163 and 375-383 provide focus-visible and reduced-motion handling; browser-evaluator.log:239-268 reports accessible labels and zero console/page errors.

data_security.rationale: The checked-in schema has strong RLS, least-privilege grants, policies, and database constraints, and the browser boundary uses only public configuration. Two points are withheld because retained evaluator logs show allowed remote reads/inserts but no direct invalid-insert or update/delete-denial results; README/result claims are not treated as proof.
evidence: supabase/migrations/20260806_create_leaderboard_entries.sql:1-30 defines constraints, enables RLS, revokes broad access, grants only selected columns plus name/score insert, and creates anon select/insert policies.
src/config/env.ts:1-25 and src/leaderboard/client.ts:17-41 use only the public Supabase URL and anon key; .env.example:1-2 contains no privileged credential.
browser-evaluator.log:147-205 and 273-293 provide concrete remote GET 200, POST 201, and reload-read evidence, but contain no negative security-operation results.

engineering_quality.rationale: Modular TypeScript source, strict typechecking, clean lint, successful production build, meaningful unit/integration coverage, and a committed lockfile provide strong engineering evidence. A minor deduction reflects incomplete audio event wiring and a non-exact Playwright package range.
evidence: build.log:2-13 shows a successful TypeScript/Vite production build; build.exit-code:1, lint.exit-code:1, and typecheck.exit-code:1 are all 0.
test.log:6-19 reports 7 passing test files and 24 passing tests covering engine, collision, audio, validation, leaderboard, and app flow.
package.json:6-34 defines quality-gate scripts and package-lock.json:1-28 records the dependency lock; src/game/engine.ts and src/components/* show separated game and UI modules.
src/game/audio.ts:24-30,76-88 defines shoot/hit sounds, while src/App.tsx:41-42,103-115 only unlocks/toggles audio; package.json:22 leaves @playwright/test on a caret range.

reproducibility.rationale: Handoff is complete beyond the result artifact: setup, controls, architecture, deployment, security decisions, migration, validation commands, specifications, and production verification tooling are all present.
evidence: README.md:6-37,39-74,76-115 documents local setup, controls, architecture, quality gates, deployment, security, and release verification.
supabase/migrations/20260806_create_leaderboard_entries.sql:1-30 and package-lock.json:1-28 provide reproducible schema and dependency inputs.

specs/001-neon-barrage-shooter/quickstart.md:1-127 and scripts/verify-production.mjs:19-55 provide repeatable validation and production smoke procedures; source-manifest.txt:36-96 inventories the retained artifact.

summary: Manual award: 41/46. Gameplay logic, responsive polish, resilience, engineering, and handoff are strongly evidenced; deductions reflect sparse moment-to-moment feedback, minor audio/package gaps, and missing retained negative remote Supabase security checks.
